method: radare2, -a arm -b 32 -m 0x84000000 -e asm.bits=16, aaa then pdf @@f. Virtual address = 0x84000000 + file offset - 0x40 (64-byte IMG3 header), same convention as iBSS_n88ap_4.3.5.
note: The binary is Apple's iBSS 4.3.1 for n90ap (iPhone 4), extracted from iPhone3,1_4.3.1_8G4_Restore.ipsw and decrypted through the device's own GID key (docs/journal/2026-10-22.md, not in this public repo), kept only under /tmp; never committed. Re-derive it with tools/decrypt_image3.sh.
